# Independent re-derivation: kic-006367225 (KBONUS-BKG, KIC 6367225, Gaia DR3 2077645628644907776, Kp 17.2)

Candidate-language only. No code under `pipeline/` was read or imported; `vet.json` / `pixel.json` were opened only after all numbers below existed. All numbers trace to `rederive_results.json` (main run, `pass2_robust` block unless stated) and `rederive_extra.json` (supplementary) in `/home/user/ZyushgPlanet/runs/poolA_main/adversarial/kic-006367225/rederive/`.

## 1. Data and detrending (own code)
- Cached FITS, `LIGHTCURVE_STITCHED`, `SAP_QUALITY == 0`: 59,685 cadences, Q1-Q17, baseline 1459.5 d.
- Per-quarter median normalisation; 1.0-d time-based running median split at gaps > 0.5 d; one-sided 4-sigma clip of positive outliers.
- A generic step detector (median of 6 cadences before vs after > 10x point-to-point sigma) found one-cadence jumps of +54 and +100 sigma in Q2 (BKJD 200.3, 246.2) and +11 sigma in Q6 (598.2, 599.2), in both PSF and SAP flux. **Pass 1** ignores them; **pass 2** (primary) also splits segments there, drops +/-0.05 d, and applies a symmetric 5-sigma clip. A 2000-ppm transit (~1 sigma per point; scatter 2605 ppm) cannot trigger either rule.

## 2. Blind BLS 1-50 d (astropy BoxLeastSquares, own log grid, 142,741 periods x 5 durations)
- **Pass 2, PSF flux:** top peak **12.97183 d** (SDE 31.0, robust SDE 33.8); peaks 2 and 3 are the P/2 (6.4860 d, SDE 18.0) and 2P (25.943 d, SDE 18.0) aliases. The inverted-flux null (2 - f) on the same data: SDE 9.5, top peak 31.18 d; at 12.95 d it ranks 27th. **Recovered blind: yes.**
- **Pass 1 (no step splitting):** top peak 45.85 d (SDE 7.7), then 48.24 d and 40.21 d, all driven by the Q2 steps; 12.93 d ranks ~60th. Recovery is therefore detrend-dependent and the Q2/Q6 discontinuities must be handled by any search on this file.

## 3. At the best ephemeris (pass 2, masked re-detrend, transit excluded from the running median)
| statistic | value |
|---|---|
| period | 12.971956 +/- 0.0015 d (HWHM of the peak) |
| t0 | BKJD 856.18195 = BJD 2455689.18195 |
| best box duration | 2.4 h (grid step 0.48 h); trapezoid T14 = 4.40 h, T23/T14 = 0.27 (V-shaped) |
| box depth | **1972 +/- 158 ppm** (empirical error = robust std of 4000 random-phase boxes of the same width; 0/4000 random boxes as deep); empirical SNR 12.5 |
| astropy BLS fitted depth | 1444 +/- 100 ppm (its out-of-transit includes the 4.4-h wings) |
| odd / even | 1847 +/- 221 vs 2107 +/- 247 ppm, **0.78 sigma** |
| secondary at phase 0.5 | 236 +/- 158 ppm, **1.5 sigma** (deepest box at any other phase: 397 ppm, 2.5 sigma) |
| per-year depth | Y1 1627 +/- 414, Y2 1738 +/- 392, Y3 2276 +/- 344, Y4 2113 +/- 344 ppm; chi2 2.0 / 3 dof |
| transits with local depth | 98 (of 113 epochs in the baseline); 87/98 positive; deepest/sum = 0.05; chi2(const) 132/97 |
| radius if on target | Rp/Rs 0.044, 4.3 Re for Rstar 0.88 Rsun (no dilution correction) |

Forced at the pipeline's period (12.97195 d after local refinement) every statistic is the same within noise (`at_pipeline_period` block: depth 1990 +/- 162 ppm).

## 4. SAP_FLUX and the dilution check
- SAP box depth at the same ephemeris: **677 +/- 49 ppm** (SNR 13.8; SAP scatter 892 ppm vs PSF 2605 ppm). **SAP/PSF = 0.34 +/- 0.04.** Per-quarter header CROWDSAP is 0.80-0.97 (PSFFRAC 0.52-0.87), so an undiluted on-target transit should give a ratio of 0.80-0.97 (or 1.0 if SAP were crowding-corrected). The two photometries cannot both be reporting the true fractional depth of a transit on this star.
- **Per season** (same module every 4th quarter; `rederive_extra.json`): PSF depth 3925 +/- 641 (mod 18), 1960 +/- 448 (mod 14), 1417 +/- 140 (mod 8), 1129 +/- 237 ppm (mod 12), chi2 18/3; SAP 474 +/- 65, 309 +/- 94, 1446 +/- 111, 383 +/- 103 ppm, chi2 75/3. SAP/PSF = 1.02 +/- 0.13 on module 8 and 0.12-0.34 elsewhere.
- **Raw (un-stitched) flux levels explain why.** The stitched columns are rescaled per quarter to a common median (1366 e/s PSF, 3765 e/s SAP). The raw per-quarter PSF-fit flux of this Kp 17.2 star (expected ~1400 e/s) is 351-445 e/s on module 18, 860-1017 on module 14, 1479-1679 on module 12 and 2246-2604 on module 8, i.e. **0.25x-1.9x**, while its raw SAP aperture (2-6 px) holds 2000-7370 e/s, **1.4-5.3x the star's whole expected flux**. The G=13.8 star 8" (2 px) away has a stable raw PSF flux (38,400-43,800 e/s). The KBONUS flux assignment between the two stars is module-dependent, and the header CROWDSAP/PSFFRAC (and the CSV psffrac 0.52 / crowdsap 0.80) do not describe this source. Any fractional depth from this file, including the pipeline's, inherits this.
- **Neighbours.** KIC 6367220 (G=13.8, TPF origin), downloaded into an isolated scratch directory and folded at the ephemeris: -10 +/- 9 ppm (PSF), -6 +/- 10 ppm (SAP), scatter 180 ppm, no odd/even or secondary structure: **excluded as the source**. The G=20.5 Gaia source 3.6" (~0.9 px) away and the G=20.9 source 9.6" away are **not in the KBONUS source catalogue** (404 from MAST, absent from the local catalogue), so they were never modelled and their light sits inside the target's PSF fit and aperture; the pipeline's pixel deficit is nearest to the G=20.5 star in Q2, 4, 7, 8 and to the target in only 2 of 14 quarters. A ~3-4% V-shaped eclipse on that star would reproduce the observed 1400-2000 ppm signal. This re-derivation cannot exclude it.

## 5. Comparison with the pipeline (`vet.json`, read afterwards)
**Agree:** period (12.971956 vs 12.971528 d, 0.3 HWHM); epoch (t0 is 55 cycles after the pipeline t0 with a 7-min offset); box duration (2.4 vs 2.25 h; T14 4.40 vs t14_max 4.12 h); odd/even (0.78 vs 0.90 sigma); no secondary (1.5 vs -0.28 sigma); flat per-year/per-quartile depths; 98 vs 100 events, 0.89 vs 0.88 positive; per-transit weighted mean 1525 vs pipeline event_weighted_depth 1519 ppm; no signal on the bright neighbour (consistent with the pipeline's scaled-image test).

**Disagree:** (1) the 3034 +/- 305 ppm depth is not reproduced by any box statistic (own 1972 +/- 158; 2099 at the pipeline's exact ephemeris and width; 1726-2273 ppm across definitions and widths), and the pipeline's own event-weighted (1519 ppm) and quartile (1112-1980 ppm) depths side with this re-derivation; the only pipeline number near 3034 is the TLS model depth (3007 ppm). (2) SAP/PSF = 0.34 against 0.80-0.97 expected; no SAP check exists in vet.json. (3) Per-season depth inconsistency (chi2 18/3 PSF, 75/3 SAP) is invisible to the pipeline's time-quartile test. (4) The dilution inputs (psffrac 0.52, crowdsap 0.80) are not credible for this source given the raw flux levels. (5) Radius: 4.3 Re (own) vs 5.28 / 4.73 Re; on-target estimates by season and photometry span ~1000-3400 ppm (3-5.5 Re). (6) The unmodelled G=20.5 star 0.9 px away is an unexcluded alternative host. (7) Blind recovery depends on handling the Q2/Q6 steps.

## 6. Verdict
A periodic 12.972-d, ~2.4-h (T14 ~4.4 h, V-shaped) flux deficit is unambiguously present in both PSF and aperture photometry of this source (independent empirical SNR 12.5 and 13.8), with consistent odd/even depths, no secondary, flat per-year depths and 87 of 98 individual events positive. Its **fractional depth is not a stable quantity for this star** (factor 3-10 between photometries and seasons, because the PSF fit and the aperture assign it 0.25x-5x its expected flux depending on the module), the pipeline's 3034 ppm is not reproduced (own ~2000 ppm), and the deficit cannot yet be assigned to the target rather than the unmodelled G=20.5 neighbour. This is a signal, not a candidate; depth and radius should be quoted as ranges until pixel-level work (ideally forward-modelling both the target and the unmodelled G=20.5 source on the TPFs, per season) resolves the host.
